Vendored unmodified from https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/arena-skill (MIT, see LICENSE),
`skills/arena/` at commit df07b8e518e10cdecd8cd7712d9958b6f396250e.

It is used only by `tools/make_fixture.py` to produce real `.arena/` run folders for the viewer
